settings.careers_heading: Different ways to be part of Haywood.
settings.careers_intro: We are not hiring for any roles right now. But if you fit golfers, run a retail business or create thoughtful golf content, there may still be a way for us to work together.
settings.careers_status_copy: When a position becomes available, we will post the complete role and application details here. We do not keep general employment applications on file between openings.
settings.careers_paths_heading: A job is not the only way in.
settings.careers_fit_copy: If you are a professional fitter or fitting facility interested in working with Haywood products, introduce yourself and tell us about your fitting experience.
settings.careers_retail_copy: Retailers and golf businesses interested in carrying Haywood can contact our team to discuss products, territory and partnership fit.
settings.careers_creator_copy: Rep Haywood is our creator program for golfers with a point of view and an audience that is listening. We choose partners by fit, not follower count.
settings.careers_contact_copy: Tell us what you have in mind and our team will point you in the right direction.
